rules.statement: At an ex parte hearing, the defendant has no right to cross-examine the plaintiff or his witnesses. If the Court is dissatisfied with the evidence adduced at such a hearing, it should adjourn either to a day named or sine die and give the plaintiff an opportunity to supplement the defective evidence.
rules.supporting_quote: If he is dissatisfied, he should in an order point out in what respects the evidence already recorded is defective and then adjourn either to a day named, or sine die. The plaintiff may put the cause on the roll when he is able to supplement the defective evidence.
